summary_1line: After Santanu’s death, Chitrangada becomes king but is slain by a Gandharva; Bhishma installs Vichitravirya and later abducts the three princesses of Kasi for him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma stands alone on his chariot while thousands of kings surround him, arrows raining like storm clouds as he shields himself with a blazing counter-shower.
The Gandharva king and Prince Chitrangada duel for years on the banks of the Saraswati at Kurukshetra beneath a sky thick with weapons.
Bhishma seizes the three princesses of Kasi onto his chariot at the swayamvara and rides away while enraged kings leap into their chariots to pursue.
